subject: [PATCH 4/5] selftests: KVM: guest_memfd: let the gmem_test() harness bind a node

2026-09-02.patch_summary: This patch extends the create_guest_memfd() function to accept a node argument, allowing the gmem_test() harness to bind a node when creating a guest memory file descriptor. The BIND_NODE flag is used to determine whether the node argument should be ignored or used for binding. This change enables testing of GUEST_MEMFD_FLAG_BIND_NODE functionality.
